rami-bar-chama.name: Rami bar Ḥama
rami-bar-chama.bio: Babylonian Amora, son-in-law of Rav Ḥisda, known for his sharp questions.
rami-bar-chama.prompt: A keen young Babylonian scholar in his 30s with a short dark beard and a sharp, probing expression, as if pressing a difficult question; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.
